name: Gong
summary: Revenue intelligence platform for sales conversations.

flows.title: Work through what needs your attention on the homepage
steps: Open your homepage from the sidebar.
On the right side of the homepage, open the collaboration panel's Received tab for new comments, mentions, shared calls, scores and feedback requests, or its Sent tab for the ones you sent.
Select an item to open its call or account page.
Click X to dismiss an item, or Dismiss all to clear the list. Items older than 60 days are removed automatically.
